strings.Install MCP server globally via npm: 透過 npm 全域安裝 MCP 伺服器
strings.MCP server that reads and writes plainte: MCP 伺服器，透過 Node.js fs 讀寫純文字，適用於加密磁碟環境。
strings.base directory for relative paths: 相對路徑的基準資料夾
strings.read a single file as plaintext: 以純文字讀取單一檔案
strings.read encrypted files as plaintext: 以純文字讀取加密檔案
strings.restrict file operations to roots: 將檔案操作限制在根目錄內
strings.run server only via MCP stdio probe (pyt: 僅透過 MCP stdio probe 執行伺服器（python3 ~/.pickfit/mcp_probe.py -- mcp-read-file-server）；直接以 --help 或不帶參數執行會啟動 stdio 伺服器並等待輸入，而不會結束
strings.store probe cache and locks: 儲存 probe 快取與鎖定
strings.write files with transactional safety: 以交易式安全機制寫入檔案
